Stryzhavka Old Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Vinnytsia Oblast, Ukraine

Demolished. Stryzhavka became the actual center of Hitler's 'Werewolf' Eastern Front headquarters compound, and beginning in December 1941, Jewish skilled workers from the town were used as forced labor to help build it — before nearly all of them were shot by an Einsatzgruppe on January 10-12, 1942. This cemetery, established in the 18th century, had its tombstones stolen to build cellars, and by the 1960s the site had been repurposed for vegetable gardens, which continue today. A local resident named Galina, born in 1953, recalled the cemetery from her childhood; the current homeowner did not permit the survey team to photograph the demolished site.
